# ui::easing

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::easing` from the rendering headers.

Named [CubicBezier](cubic-bezier.md) curves and the CPU-side evaluator.

## Functions

### evaluate

```cpp
float evaluate(const CubicBezier& c, double x)
```

Header: `winui/render/CubicBezier.hpp`.

Evaluates `c` at elapsed-time fraction `x`, returning the progress fraction (the curve's y at the t where its x equals `x`), for a control that eases a value itself, such as [Expander](../layout/expander.md#uiexpander)'s content slide or the toggle knob. `x` is clamped to 0..1.

x(t) is inverted by 24 steps of bisection, which puts t within 2^-24, far finer than any frame can show.
